descriptionChirho: Aramaic noun קָל (qal) meaning 'sound' or 'voice,' used both in construct state ('sound of') and as an absolute/prepositional noun ('with voice,' 'a voice'). Eng 'sound of / voice / with voice,' Spa 'el sonido de / una voz / con voz,' Hin 'आवाज / आवाज से,' Arb 'صَوْتَ / صَوْتٌ / بِصَوْتٍ,' Kor '소리를 / 소리로,' Swa 'sauti ya / sauti.' The construct and absolute/prepositional forms represent grammatical variation of the same lexical meaning, not distinct senses.
